meta.title: Support the Studio — Erveca Studio
meta.desc: Support Erveca Studio by buying our games, merch or making a direct donation. Every gesture helps us keep creating from La Rioja.
support.label: Support the studio
support.title:
Every gesture
keeps us alive
support.lead: We are a small studio in a village in the Cameros mountains. No publishers, no investors. If what we do speaks to you, here are the ways you can help us keep going.
support.buy.title: Buy our games
support.buy.desc: Every download counts. Almazuela Picross is available on Google Play and Steam. It's the most direct way to support us and, while you're at it, enjoy our culture.
support.donate.title: Buy us a coffee
support.donate.desc: If you want to contribute directly to the studio without buying anything in return, you can make a free donation through PayPal. No minimums, no subscriptions.
support.merch.eyebrow: Take a piece of Pradillo home
support.merch.title: Merchandise
support.merch.desc: Keychains and items inspired by Almazuela Picross, made with love. A way to carry the studio in your pocket, literally.
support.note:
Creating from a small mountain village is part of who we are. Every donation, every coffee and every gesture of support lets us keep bringing our ideas to life from Pradillo. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

— Samuel and Isabel, Erveca Studio
